knowledge.title: Booking limits

goal: Send a message to a contact
name: JustCall

steps.instruction: Open Contacts in the left menu.
Type their name in the search box — at least four letters.

steps.objective: Open the message box for that contact
steps.instruction: On their row, choose the message icon on the right.
Type your message, then choose Send SMS.
Choose Add a number to open your phone numbers.
Now choose Add Number, top right.
Open Select Country and pick your country.
Pick a number type — local, or toll free.
That is your number. Keep it, or choose a different one, then choose Save and Next.
Check the summary, then choose Add number to finish.

journeys.goal: Send a message to a contact

steps.instruction: Open Contacts in the left menu.

steps.objective: Narrow the list to that one person
steps.instruction: Type their name in the search box. I will wait until only they are showing.
Now choose the message icon on the far right of their row.
Type your message, choose Send SMS, then Done to close it.

knowledge.body: Five steps: make your first call or send an SMS, set up your first outbound campaign, let an AI Voice Agent take your calls, connect the tools you already use, and invite your team.
knowledge.title: What is on the Get Started page

knowledge.body: Talk to AIVA opens a modal on this page where you can test your AI Voice Agent. It offers a Phone Call tab, which rings your phone, and a Web Call tab, which talks in the browser.
knowledge.title: Talk to AIVA

knowledge.body: Test calls are limited per day and the allowance resets every 24 hours to keep things fair and spam-free.
knowledge.title: AIVA trial call limits

knowledge.body: Make a call, Send an SMS, Create a campaign and Create AI Voice Agent all open a different page in a new browser tab. Only Talk to AIVA stays on this page.
knowledge.title: Where the other buttons go

knowledge.body: Only account owners and admins. Other roles are redirected to the dashboard.
knowledge.title: Who can see Get Started

knowledge.body: Choose Invite your team on the Get Started page. Enter an email address, pick Team Member or Admin, then choose Invite. Your existing number is shared with the people you invite, and they can also buy their own numbers.
knowledge.title: Inviting team members

knowledge.body: Make a call takes you to the dialer in this same tab. Send an SMS opens the messaging page.
knowledge.title: Make a call from Get Started

knowledge.body: Yes. When you first open the JustCall dashboard a free number is already reserved for you — click 'Get this number' to claim it. If you'd rather have a different one, open the Phone Numbers section, click 'Add Number', and choose a country and number type.
knowledge.title: Do I get a free phone number when I sign up?
